quoteTypes.name: New website from scratch
quoteTypes.description: Design and build one website from scratch, with nothing reused from an existing platform.

quoteTypes.name: New platform and rollout
quoteTypes.description: Build a new multisite platform from scratch, then roll out the portfolio of sites onto it.

quoteTypes.name: New site on an existing foundation
quoteTypes.description: Build a site for a sub brand or sister organisation by reusing a platform foundation Anyday already built.

quoteTypes.name: Expand a platform we already run
quoteTypes.description: Add new sites to a live Anyday platform. Volume pricing continues from the sites already live.

sections.name: WebOps Base + Design
sections.intro: The shared implementation and design work built once and reused across every site.

sections.name: Migration
sections.intro: Moving the sites' pages, records, media and URLs onto the platform.

sections.name: Platform Extensions
sections.intro: Supported configuration and cleanup beyond core migration volume.

items.name: Core multisite platform
items.what: A new shared multisite platform built from scratch: CMS, front end framework, hosting pipeline and shared foundations.
items.receives: A production ready platform that every current and future site can run on.
items.sourceNotes: Foundation layer used by every future site.

items.name: Standard reusable page template
items.what: A new reusable page structure built once for the platform.
items.receives: One new page template editors can reuse on any site.

items.name: Advanced reusable page template
items.what: A new reusable page structure with complex layout or behaviour.
items.receives: One advanced page template with its interactive behaviour.
items.sourceNotes: Complex reusable page structure or behavior.

items.name: Standard reusable component
items.what: A new reusable content block added to the shared library.
items.receives: One new block with its fields, rendering and editor experience.

items.name: Advanced reusable component
items.what: A new reusable block with complex behaviour, data or interaction.
items.receives: One advanced block with its fields, logic, rendering and editor experience.

items.name: Structured content model
items.what: A new repeatable content type such as news, events, people, projects or resources.
items.receives: One content model with fields, editor views and listing or detail rendering.
items.sourceNotes: News, events, people, projects, resources, etc.

items.name: Standard brand controls
items.what: Global brand controls for colours, typography and logos.
items.receives: A brand control set editors can use to theme a site.
items.sourceNotes: Colors, typography, logos and core global controls.

items.name: Advanced brand controls
items.what: Expanded theme system covering radius, spacing, widths, imagery, headers, footers and section variation.
items.receives: An advanced theme control set for deeper brand variation between sites.
items.sourceNotes: Radius, spacing, widths, imagery, headers, footers and section variation.

items.name: Additional global design control
items.what: One additional global styling control added to the theme system.
items.receives: One new reusable design control.

items.name: Existing shared integration
items.what: Enable an integration the platform already supports.
items.receives: The integration switched on and configured for shared use.

items.name: New shared integration
items.what: A new reusable integration added to the shared platform.
items.receives: A new integration available to every site.
items.sourceNotes: New reusable integration added to base.

items.name: New simple API integration
items.what: Connect one external service with a simple read or write.
items.receives: A working connection to one external service.

items.name: New advanced API integration
items.what: Connect a service with multiple endpoints, authentication, transforms, sync or error handling.
items.receives: A robust connection to one complex external service.
items.sourceNotes: Multiple endpoints, auth, transforms, sync or error handling.

items.name: Additional API endpoint
items.what: One more endpoint on an existing API connection.
items.receives: One additional endpoint wired into the platform.

items.name: Webhook workflow
items.what: An automated workflow triggered by an event in another system.
items.receives: One reusable webhook workflow.

items.name: New structured data source
items.what: A new external data source feeding structured content.
items.receives: One reusable data source connection.

items.name: Complex synchronized data source
items.what: An external data source kept in ongoing sync with the platform.
items.receives: One continuously synchronised data source.

items.name: Additional data mapping
items.what: One additional mapping between external data and platform content.
items.receives: One reusable data mapping.

items.name: Scheduled synchronization
items.what: A data sync that runs on a schedule.
items.receives: One reusable scheduled synchronisation.

items.name: Standard site search
items.what: Standard search across site content.
items.receives: A reusable site search capability.

items.name: Faceted search
items.what: Search with filters and facets.
items.receives: Filterable search results with facets.

items.name: External search platform integration
items.what: Connect an external search platform such as Algolia or Elastic.
items.receives: Search powered by the chosen external platform.

items.name: Additional search index
items.what: One more search index for a distinct content set.
items.receives: One additional reusable search index.

items.name: Search across multiple content types
items.what: Unified search across several content types.
items.receives: One search experience spanning multiple content models.

items.name: Translation API connection
items.what: Connect a translation service to the platform.
items.receives: A reusable translation integration.

items.name: Localization architecture
items.what: Locale architecture and routing for multilingual sites.
items.receives: Reusable locale structure, routing and editor support.

items.name: Simple donation or payment flow
items.what: A simple donation or payment flow.
items.receives: One reusable payment or donation flow.

items.name: Commerce platform integration
items.what: Connect a commerce platform.
items.receives: A reusable commerce platform connection.

items.name: Product catalogue
items.what: A product catalogue content structure and display.
items.receives: A reusable product catalogue.

items.name: Full commerce implementation
items.what: A full commerce implementation.
items.receives: A complete commerce capability, scoped in detail before confirmation.

items.name: Basic authenticated area
items.what: A signed in area for members.
items.receives: A reusable authenticated member area.

items.name: User profiles
items.what: Member profiles.
items.receives: A reusable profile capability.

items.name: Dashboard
items.what: A member dashboard.
items.receives: A reusable dashboard.

items.name: Role based permissions
items.what: Role based permissions for members or editors.
items.receives: A reusable permission model.

items.name: External identity provider
items.what: Single sign on or an external identity provider.
items.receives: Sign in through the chosen identity provider.

items.name: Complex portal
items.what: A complex member portal.
items.receives: A portal capability, scoped in detail before confirmation.
items.sourceNotes: Starting point for a complex portal.

items.name: Simple gated resource
items.what: A resource that requires a simple gate before access.
items.receives: A reusable gated content pattern.

items.name: Registration gate
items.what: Content unlocked by registration.
items.receives: A reusable registration gate.

items.name: CRM connected gate
items.what: Gated content connected to the CRM.
items.receives: A reusable CRM connected gate.

items.name: Role based gated content
items.what: Content gated by member role.
items.receives: Reusable role based gating.

items.name: Simple interactive tool
items.what: A reusable interactive tool such as a selector, calculator or explorer.
items.receives: One interactive tool, scoped in detail before confirmation.
items.sourceNotes: Starting point for a reusable interactive tool.

items.name: Data driven application
items.what: A data driven application inside the platform.
items.receives: One data driven application, scoped in detail before confirmation.
items.sourceNotes: Starting point for a reusable data driven app.

items.name: Site activation
items.what: Set up each site on the platform: CMS project, settings, deployment, QA, domain and launch.
items.receives: Each site live on the platform.
items.sourceNotes: CMS setup, settings, deployment, QA, domain and launch.

items.name: Level 1 composed page migration
items.what: A major page requiring substantial assembly.
items.receives: The page rebuilt on the platform with its content and blocks.

items.name: Level 2 composed page migration
items.what: A supporting page assembled from established patterns.
items.receives: The page rebuilt on the platform from existing blocks.
items.sourceNotes: Supporting page assembled from established patterns.

items.name: Level 3 simple page migration
items.what: A simple, standardised page with limited assembly.
items.receives: The page migrated into a standard layout.

items.name: Bulk static pages
items.what: Near identical static pages migrated in bulk instead of page by page.
items.receives: The page set migrated with a shared layout.
items.sourceNotes: Use instead of composed page pricing when pages are near identical. Additional block.

items.name: Structured records
items.what: Repeatable content such as articles, news, events, people, projects and resources.
items.receives: Records migrated into structured content models.
items.sourceNotes: Blogs, news, events, people, members, projects and similar. Applied in 500 record blocks.

items.name: Source content type mapping
items.what: Map each legacy content type to its new content model.
items.receives: A documented, implemented mapping for each source content type.
items.sourceNotes: Legacy content type to new model.

items.name: Media assets
items.what: Images, files and other media moved into the new media library.
items.receives: Media assets migrated and linked to their content.
items.sourceNotes: Images, files and media. Applied in 1,000 asset blocks.

items.name: Redirect mapping
items.what: Old URLs that change are mapped to their new location.
items.receives: A tested redirect map for the URLs that change.
items.sourceNotes: First redirect block. Additional redirect block.

items.name: Basic migration cleanup
items.what: Basic automated cleanup during migration.
items.receives: Content imported with standard automated cleanup.

items.name: Automated field normalization
items.what: Systematic normalisation of field values for a content type.
items.receives: Consistent field values for each normalised content type.

items.name: Broken HTML cleanup
items.what: Systematic cleanup of malformed HTML in migrated records.
items.receives: Clean rich text in the affected records.

items.name: URL normalization
items.what: Systematic normalisation of URL structure for a site.
items.receives: Consistent URL patterns for the site.

items.name: Metadata cleanup
items.what: Systematic cleanup of record metadata.
items.receives: Consistent metadata in the affected records.

items.name: Enable existing translation integration
items.what: Activate the supported translation workflow on a site.
items.receives: Translation workflow enabled for the site.

items.name: Additional language configuration
items.what: Configure one additional language.
items.receives: One more language available to editors and visitors.

items.name: Enable localization architecture
items.what: Activate the existing locale architecture on a site.
items.receives: Locale routing and editor support enabled for the site.

items.name: Locale specific navigation
items.what: Navigation specific to one locale.
items.receives: A dedicated navigation for each locale.

items.name: Locale specific content rules
items.what: Rules for which content appears in which locale.
items.receives: Locale content rules configured for the site.

items.name: Region specific site variation
items.what: A regional variation of a site.
items.receives: One configured regional variation.

items.name: Brand configuration
items.what: Apply the site's logo, colours and fonts using existing global controls.
items.receives: The site styled with its brand using existing controls.
items.sourceNotes: Logo, colors, fonts and existing global controls.

items.name: Existing CRM integration setup
items.what: Configure a CRM the platform already supports.
items.receives: The site connected to its CRM.

items.name: Standard form connection
items.what: Connect one standard form.
items.receives: One working form connected to its destination.

items.name: Advanced form workflow
items.what: Configure one advanced supported form workflow.
items.receives: One advanced form workflow.

items.name: Newsletter integration
items.what: Connect the supported newsletter integration.
items.receives: Newsletter sign up connected for the site.

items.name: Existing API integration setup
items.what: Configure an integration that already exists in the base.
items.receives: The existing integration configured for the site.
items.sourceNotes: Configure an integration already in base.

items.name: Existing data source setup
items.what: Configure a supported data source for a site.
items.receives: The data source connected for the site.

items.name: Existing search configuration
items.what: Configure the shared search for a site.
items.receives: Search configured and working for the site.

items.name: Member directory configuration
items.what: Configure the existing member directory pattern for a site.
items.receives: A working member directory for the site.

items.name: Analytics configuration and validation
items.what: Configure and validate analytics.
items.receives: Analytics configured and validated for the site.

items.name: SEO metadata migration
items.what: Migrate SEO metadata into the new content model.
items.receives: Titles, descriptions and social metadata carried over.

items.name: Existing commerce setup
items.what: Configure the supported commerce capability for a site.
items.receives: Commerce configured for the site.

items.name: Existing gated content setup
items.what: Configure the supported gated content pattern for a site.
items.receives: Gated content configured for the site.

items.name: Visual direction and brand application
items.what: Establish the visual direction and apply the brand across the component library and page templates.
items.receives: An approved visual direction: type, colour, imagery and component styling applied across the component library.
items.sourceNotes: Design rates not established in source workbooks.

items.name: Component design
items.what: Design of the components in scope. On a new platform this is each new reusable component. On an existing foundation it is each existing component chosen for visual redesign, which keeps its schema and behaviour; new fields, filters, workflows or functionality are separate development scope.
items.receives: Approved designs for each component, counted once however often it appears.
items.sourceNotes: Design rates not established in source workbooks.

items.name: Representative page layout designs
items.what: Full page designs for representative templates that show how the components compose.
items.receives: Approved designs for each representative page layout.
items.sourceNotes: Design rates not established in source workbooks.

items.name: Design review rounds
items.what: Structured review and revision rounds on the design work.
items.receives: Consolidated feedback rounds with revised designs.
items.sourceNotes: Design rates not established in source workbooks.
